findings: The durable account gate is satisfied chronologically. Account revisions 1a5239ed3375b00d4d6513e0b3483a63eeaca85c, 12022987d7f48d78b50c514f66825c7c1c906fad, and 4f67bb5478b9b6499a6ab236edb4f3f2f8decf8e all precede immutable implementation commit 3538e6c46cb73a426a5e8af66b8b89907f2a9707, and the final account explicitly falsifies the earlier cgraph-name and schema-binding hypotheses before locating the claimed loss in final SVG emission.

Pinned Java source supports the model that PlantUML binds solved splines and label positions by per-link marker color rather than by endpoint geometry. CucaDiagramFileMakerSvek.getOrderedLinks preserves same-connection source order while grouping, Bibliotekon.addLine retains every SvekEdge in insertion-owned collections, SvekEdge.appendLine emits each edge with a unique lineColor and noteLabelColor, and SvekEdge.solveLine/getXY recover the path and label positions by searching the rendered SVG for those colors.

Static Rust inspection supports the narrow implementation claim for flat states. LayoutGraph appends EdgeSpec values and returns their insertion index, records the returned Agedge_t pointer in edge_specs, and later fills EdgePath.edge_index from that pointer while walking cgraph in traversal order. Commit 3538e6c4 changes flat final transition emission and the flat label-bound calculations to resolve each transition through flat_transition_layout_edges and EdgePath.edge_index instead of consuming paths by endpoint distance.

Static review found no golden reads, include_str/include_bytes fixture embedding, fixture path checks, label-text conditionals, per-branch-count constant ladders, coordinate-keyed SVG surgery, comparator changes, guard changes, park/error-list changes, or new parity constants in 3538e6c4's production diff. The no-oracle baseline increases state from 882/901 to 883/901 and rides in the implementation commit.

The two implementation-added held-outs pass exactly in an immutable 3538e6c4 archive: renamed_two_links_labels_exchanged and renamed_three_links_reordered both report structural equivalence. This confirms the change fixed the narrow fork/join same-endpoint cases that motivated the implementation.

The fresh review_reversed_parallel_lazy_pseudos held-out also passes exactly. It varies lazy declaration order, start/end pseudostates, a forward lane, a reverse-command lane, an explicit right lane, and distinct control routes, so the flat transition-to-EdgePath map is not merely keyed to fixture names or the original two- and three-link shapes.

The fresh review_label_bound_owner_four_lane held-out rejects the mechanism's accepted surface. Java and Rust both produce the same labels and link IDs, but Rust renders a 1051px canvas where Java renders 1061px and shifts the same-endpoint parallel cluster plus adjacent control routes. This is a valid-syntax same-endpoint route and label-bound ownership case not derivable by renaming the maker fixtures.

The fresh review_self_loop_reversed_lazy_matrix held-out rejects the account's statement that self links are covered by the exact transition-to-layout-edge lookup. Java renders width 810px while Rust renders width 847px; diff_one reports only the root SVG width/viewBox mismatch. The input combines four self loops, a reverse self-loop command, an explicit right self-loop command, and varied label widths.

The fresh review_compound_endpoint_parallel_order held-out rejects acceptance for the requested compound-endpoint surface. Java renders 602x718 while Rust renders 530x719 and shifts the compound, its inner pseudostates, and every related route. This may include broader compound-frontier drift, but as an adversarial route-identity review it is still a valid preserved counterexample for the claimed route ownership mechanism at compound endpoints.

The exact immutable snapshot passes cargo fmt --check, 695/695 rustuml-render release library tests, and the no-oracle ratchet at 11050/11251 eligible pairs with state at 883/901. Those green checks do not cover the fresh held-out failures and therefore do not satisfy the T14 adversarial maker/checker gate.

Verdict is rejected. The implementation is real and mechanism-shaped for the narrow flat fork/join cases, but fresh valid held-outs show the route-identity account is incomplete for four-lane label-bound ownership, parallel self-loop envelope ownership, and compound endpoints. The failing pairs are preserved as executable counterexamples.
